title: The Second Resonance
summary: Following their escape from Saint Mirren, Ha-Jun and Min-Jae take shelter in a disused subway depot. Kuro's Feather pulses with violent violet light, homing in on an antique vault in Insa-dong where the Ring of Hollow Blood slumbers.

panels.action: Faint moonlight trickles through rusted steel ventilation grates onto abandoned train cars.
panels.prose_en: Faint moonlight trickles through rusted steel ventilation grates onto abandoned train cars.
panels.prose_hi: Zang lage steel ventilation jhanjhari se fiki chandni parityakt train karon par tapak rahi hai.

panels.action: Min-Jae opens an emergency medical kit on an overturned wooden crate, hands trembling slightly.
panels.prose_en: Min-Jae opens an emergency medical kit on an overturned wooden crate, hands trembling slightly.
panels.prose_hi: Min-je ek ulte lakdi ke tokre par ek aapatkalin chikitsa kit kholta hai, haath thoda kamp raha hai.

panels.action: Ha-Jun rests against the corrugated steel wall of a subway car, his uniform torn and dusted with concrete powder.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Shukriya, Min-Jae... Agar tum na aate, toh Captain Baek mujhe pakad leta.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun rests against the corrugated steel wall of a subway car, his uniform torn and dusted with concrete powder.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ek subway car ki nalidar steel ki deewar ke samne aaram kar raha hai, uski vardi fati hui hai aur concrete powder se sunny hui hai.

panels.action: Min-Jae tightly wraps sterile gauze around Ha-Jun's scraped knuckles.

dialogue.speaker: min-jae
dialogue.text: Dosti mein hisaab nahi hota, Ha-Jun. Lekin jo maine dekha... woh koi ordinary magic nahi tha.

panels.prose_en: Min-Jae tightly wraps sterile gauze around Ha-Jun's scraped knuckles.
panels.prose_hi: Min-je ne Ha-Jun ke chhile hue poron ke charon or banjh dhundh kaskar lapet di.

panels.shot: kuro perched on rusted steel girder
panels.action: Kuro folds his obsidian wings on an overhead steel beam, his red eyes piercing the darkness.

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Ordinary? Heh! Yeh ancient Sovereign ki authority hai, ladke.

panels.prose_en: Kuro folds his obsidian wings on an overhead steel beam, his red eyes piercing the darkness.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro apne obsidian pankhon ko ek overhead steel beam par modata hai, uski lal aankhen andhere ko bhedati han.

panels.action: Inside Ha-Jun's breast pocket, Kuro's Fallen Feather suddenly ignites with a violent neon-violet pulse.
panels.prose_en: Inside Ha-Jun's breast pocket, Kuro's Fallen Feather suddenly ignites with a violent neon-violet pulse.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ki chhati ki jeb ke ander, Kuro ka gira hua pankh achanak ek hinsak niyan-bangni naadi ke saath prajvalit ho jata hai.

panels.action: Ha-Jun winces as a sharp electric jolt travels from the feather straight into his heart ventricles.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Yeh aag... mere seene mein achanak itni tez kyu jalne lagi?!

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun winces as a sharp electric jolt travels from the feather straight into his heart ventricles.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ki halat tab bigadti hai jab ek tej bijli ka jhatka pankh se sidhe uske hriday ke nilay mein jata hai.

panels.action: The obsidian feather slips out of the blazer pocket, levitating horizontally in midair, pointing dead north.
panels.prose_en: The obsidian feather slips out of the blazer pocket, levitating horizontally in midair, pointing dead north.
panels.prose_hi: Obseedian pankh blazer ki jeb se fisal jata hai, madhya hawa mein kshaitij roop se udta hua, mrit uttar ki or ishara karta hai.

panels.action: Kuro glides down from the girder, feathers bristling with excitement: 'Dusra Relic jaag chuka hai!'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: The Ring of Hollow Blood... usne tumhari awakened wavelength pakad li hai!

panels.prose_en: Kuro glides down from the girder, feathers bristling with excitement: 'Dusra Relic jaag chuka hai!'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro utsaah se pankh failate hue garder se neeche utarta hai: 'dusra avashesh jaag chuka hai!'.

panels.action: A glowing purple-black holographic system window projects into Ha-Jun's retina.

dialogue.text:
[QUEST TRIGGERED: THE BASIC SEAL - PART 1]
Claim the Ring of Hollow Blood within 60 minutes.
Location: Insa-dong Vault 07.
Penalty upon failure: Bloodline Instability.

panels.prose_en: A glowing purple-black holographic system window projects into Ha-Jun's retina.
panels.prose_hi: Ek chamakti bangni-kali holographic system window Ha-Jun ki retina mein project karti hai.

panels.action: Ha-Jun's violet pupils narrow as a 59:59 digital countdown begins ticking backward.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Ek ghante ka waqt... aur penalty 'Bloodline Instability'?

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun's violet pupils narrow as a 59:59 digital countdown begins ticking backward.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ki baingani putliyan sankirna ho gai kyonki 59:59 digital ulti ginti peeche ki or tikne lagti hai.

panels.action: Kuro lands on Ha-Jun's shoulder, whispering into his ear: 'Yeh ring tumhare khoon ko physical weapon banayegi.'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Agar Bureau ke Hunters pehle pahunch gaye, toh woh ise destroy kar denge.

panels.prose_en: Kuro lands on Ha-Jun's shoulder, whispering into his ear: 'Yeh ring tumhare khoon ko physical weapon banayegi.'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro Ha-Jun ke kandhe par baithta hai, aur uske kaan mein fusfusata hai: 'ye anguthi tumhare khoon ko sharirik hathiyar banaegi.'

panels.action: Min-Jae unrolls a city metro blueprint across the hood of a toolcart.

dialogue.speaker: min-jae
dialogue.text: Insa-dong Vault 07... yeh purani Japanese colonial bank ke underground basement mein hai!

panels.prose_en: Min-Jae unrolls a city metro blueprint across the hood of a toolcart.
panels.prose_hi: Min-je ek tolkart ke hud par ek shahar metro blueprint ko kholta hai.

panels.action: High above the subway vent on street level, a sleek black Demon Hunter Bureau surveillance drone hovers silently.
panels.prose_en: High above the subway vent on street level, a sleek black Demon Hunter Bureau surveillance drone hovers silently.
panels.prose_hi: Sadk ke star par subway vent ke upar, ek chikna kala danav hunter bureau nigrani drone chupchap mandarata hai.

panels.action: The drone's infrared scanner flashes crimson, locking onto demonic mana heat rising from below.
panels.prose_en: The drone's infrared scanner flashes crimson, locking onto demonic mana heat rising from below.
panels.prose_hi: Dron ka infrared scanner lal rang ki chamak deta hai, jo neeche se uthne wali shaitani demonic man ki garmi ko lock kar deta hai.

panels.action: Ha-Jun's eyes flare violet as his heightened sensory field catches the high-frequency motor hum.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Hunters humare peeche hain. Humein abhi nikalna hoga.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun's eyes flare violet as his heightened sensory field catches the high-frequency motor hum.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ki aankhen baingani rang ki chamakti hain kyonki uska badha hua sanvedi kshetra ucch-aavritti motor gadgdahat ko pakadta hai.

panels.action: Min-Jae slings his tactical laptop backpack over his shoulders, nodding resolutely.

dialogue.speaker: min-jae
dialogue.text: Main tunnel switches hack kar ke security doors lock kar deta hoon.

panels.prose_en: Min-Jae slings his tactical laptop backpack over his shoulders, nodding resolutely.
panels.prose_hi: Min-je apne samrik laptop backpack ko apne kandhon par latkate hue dridhta se sir hilate han.

panels.action: Ha-Jun kicks off the gravel with superhuman agility, leaping effortlessly atop a train carriage.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun kicks off the gravel with superhuman agility, leaping effortlessly atop a train carriage.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun alaukik chapalta ke saath railgadi ke dibbe ke upar sahajta se chhalang lagate hue bajri se takrata hai.

panels.action: Wisps of violet energy coil around Ha-Jun's sneakers, suppressing all footstep sound into complete silence.
panels.prose_en: Wisps of violet energy coil around Ha-Jun's sneakers, suppressing all footstep sound into complete silence.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ke sneakers ke charon or baingani urja ki kiranen ghum rahi han, jo sabhi kadmon ki awaaz ko puri tarah se shant kar deti han.

panels.action: Ha-Jun blurs through the pitch-black maintenance tunnel at 60 km/h, rain dripping from overhead pipes.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun blurs through the pitch-black maintenance tunnel at 60 km/h, rain dripping from overhead pipes.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun 60 kimi/ghanta ki raftaar se pich-kali rakhrakhav surang ke madhyam se dhundhla ho jata hai, overhead pipe se baarish tapakti hai.

panels.action: Kuro darts ahead through the arched brick tunnel, his wings cutting the damp air.

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Do sau meter bacha hai! Upar antique shop ka basement hai!

panels.prose_en: Kuro darts ahead through the arched brick tunnel, his wings cutting the damp air.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro dhanushakar int surang ke madhyam se aage badhta hai, uske pankh nam hawa ko kaatate han.

panels.action: A heavy circular Victorian steel bulkhead hatch covered in demonic talismans is bolted into the ceiling.
panels.prose_en: A heavy circular Victorian steel bulkhead hatch covered in demonic talismans is bolted into the ceiling.
panels.prose_hi: Shaitani demonic tavison se dhaki ek bhari golakar victorian steel balkahed hatch chhat mein lagi hui hai.

panels.action: The parchment talismans on the hatch hiss and curl into yellow embers as Ha-Jun's sovereign mana touches them.
panels.prose_en: The parchment talismans on the hatch hiss and curl into yellow embers as Ha-Jun's sovereign mana touches them.
panels.prose_hi: Jaise hi Ha-Jun ka samprabhu man unhen chhuta hai, hatch par maujood charmpatra taveez funfkarte hain aur peele angaron mein badal jaate han.

panels.action: Ha-Jun grips the rusted cast-iron hatch wheel with both hands, muscles tensing beneath his torn blazer.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun grips the rusted cast-iron hatch wheel with both hands, muscles tensing beneath his torn blazer.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun zang lage kacche lohe ke hatch wheel ko donon hathon se pakadta hai, uske fate blazer ke neeche ki manspeshiyan tan jaati han.

panels.action: With a thunderous screech of shearing metal, the frozen locking pins snap and the circular hatch swings downward.
panels.prose_en: With a thunderous screech of shearing metal, the frozen locking pins snap and the circular hatch swings downward.
panels.prose_hi: Lohe ke katarne ki tej awaz ke sath, jame hue locking pin toot jaate hain aur golakar hatch neeche ki or jhool jata hai.

panels.action: Centuries of thick dust, cobwebs, and stale air pour down into the tunnel around Ha-Jun's silhouette.
panels.prose_en: Centuries of thick dust, cobwebs, and stale air pour down into the tunnel around Ha-Jun's silhouette.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ke chhayachitra ke charon or sadiyon purani moti dhul, makdi ke jale aur basi hawa surang mein girti hai.

panels.action: Ha-Jun hoists himself through the circular aperture into a shadowy, candlelit antique vault.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun hoists himself through the circular aperture into a shadowy, candlelit antique vault.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun golakar chhidra ke madhyam se khud ko ek saaye wale, mombatti ki roshni wali prachin tijori mein fahrata hai.

panels.action: Towering wooden curio cabinets filled with forbidden cursed artifacts, broken demonic masks, and jars of dark ichor.
panels.prose_en: Towering wooden curio cabinets filled with forbidden cursed artifacts, broken demonic masks, and jars of dark ichor.
panels.prose_hi: Varjit shapit kalakritiyon, toote hue shaitani demonic mukhauton aur gahre ichor ke jar se bhari hui unchi lakdi ki curio almariyan.

panels.action: In the dead center of the chamber, an obsidian pedestal radiates a rhythmic, hypnotic crimson heartbeat pulse.
panels.prose_en: In the dead center of the chamber, an obsidian pedestal radiates a rhythmic, hypnotic crimson heartbeat pulse.
panels.prose_hi: Kaksh ke mrit kendra men, ek obsidian kursi ek laybaddh, sammohak lal dil ki dhadkan naadi ko wikirn karti hai.

panels.shot: macro on the ring of hollow blood
panels.action: Resting on black velvet inside a fractured glass dome: a dark obsidian band inset with a swirling liquid-blood crimson gem.

dialogue.text:
[TARGET LOCATED: RING OF HOLLOW BLOOD (BASIC RELIC)]
Bloodline Compatibility: 98.4%

panels.prose_en: Resting on black velvet inside a fractured glass dome: a dark obsidian band inset with a swirling liquid-blood crimson gem.
panels.prose_hi: Khandit kaanch ke gumbad ke andar kale makhmal par aaram karte hue: ek ghumta hua taral-khoon lal rang ka ratna ke saath ek gehra obsidian band.
